Which ways to sign in this install offers: a username and password
(PASSWORD_SIGNIN, app/web/signin.py), OIDC, or both.

schema.title: Response Auth Config Api V1 Auth Config Get

get.description: Finish the sign-in: exchange the code, read the ID token, sign in.
Whether the web app should show a sign-in button, and its label.

schema.title: Response Oidc Config Api V1 Auth Oidc Config Get

get.description:
Send the person to the provider. authlib keeps the state/nonce/PKCE
verifier in the session cookie and checks them at the callback.

Where to come back to (the `next` query parameter) is kept in the session
too: the callback URL is registered exactly on the provider, so nothing
may be appended to it (app/main.py, _sign_in_url).

post.description: Sign out of Movie Night only (the provider keeps its own session).

schema.title: Response Oidc Logout Api V1 Auth Oidc Logout Post

get.description: Grid behind a row's "See all", one page at a time.
Watchlist / favourites / ratings as a grid.
Filtered TMDB browsing (the Discover tab); the same filters make a smart list.
Everything Movie Night keeps for you, as one JSON file.

post.description:
Delete watches from the History page (any title, including ones with
no TMDB match).

get.description: The tab's enabled rows, in order; the page then loads each one.

patch.description: Rename (own lists), show on Home, star.

Add an MDBList list to the install's MDBList lists (kept in step daily).

get.description:
No query: MDBList's top lists. A link or list id: that list. Any
other text: list search. Answered from Movie Night's own copy while
MDBList can't (services/mdblist_copy.py).

A list before following it: details and its titles as cards (from
Movie Night's own copy while MDBList can't answer).

Confirm the code Kodi (or another TV app) shows: it can then report
what you watch, and nothing else.

Sign in to Jellyfin once; only the resulting token is kept (encrypted),
never the password.

A code to type into a Jellyfin app where you're signed in
(Settings → Quick Connect).

A new token for other players to report watches; shown once. Making a
new one turns the old one off.

get.description: Back in Movie Night: the Play to ask "Finished it?" about now, if any.

post.description: The player sent the person back from this Play: whether to ask now.

get.description:
Seerr requests, newest first (everyone's, or yours), with live status
and download progress: 40 a page, every page reachable ("more"), and
how many in all.

post.description:
Events from the Movie Night plugin for Jellyfin, for every app that
plays through Jellyfin: playback start, progress, pause and stop keep
watch progress; played and unplayed marks keep history. Same shared
secret as the webhook (X-MovieNight-Token).

get.description:
Your library, every rated title on TMDB (the catalog index: by meaning
and keywords, so a described plot works) and TMDB's live title search
(new releases, exact names), ranked on one scale. `first` says which
section holds the best match. `page` 2, 3, ... answers with more of each
section (the matches before included); `more` says which have more.

The AI's best guess for a described plot (only when SEARCH_AI_MODEL is
set): the films it names, as cards, each with a few words on why.

post.description: Pull your Jellyfin plays now (it also happens every few minutes).
Install-wide: rescan the Jellyfin library, or re-sync MDBList lists.

delete.description:
Unlike one episode: its row is deleted. An episode that wasn't
liked is not an error.

post.description:
Like one episode (the heart on the season page). Liking it again
changes nothing. It doesn't favourite the show.

delete.description:
Remove one episode's rating: its row is deleted. An episode that
wasn't rated is not an error.

post.description:
Rate one episode, 1 to 10 like a title (the stars next to its heart on
the season page); rating it again replaces the rating. PUT or POST. It
doesn't rate the show, and it isn't counted in Ratings, Your ratings, the
community average, the AI picks or digests.

put.description:
Rate one episode, 1 to 10 like a title (the stars next to its heart on
the season page); rating it again replaces the rating. PUT or POST. It
doesn't rate the show, and it isn't counted in Ratings, Your ratings, the
community average, the AI picks or digests.

post.description: Tick or untick episodes (a whole season is a list of them).

get.description: "More like this" and, for movies, the rest of the collection.

post.description:
Send the request to Seerr as this person. A 409 from Seerr (it already
has one) is not an error: the button moves to that request's status.
Shows can ask for some seasons only.

get.description:
IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd and Trakt scores, and a
plain note when MDBList couldn't refresh them (it refused or didn't
answer).

post.description: Posters for cards that arrived without one (big lists).
